name: Higgsfield
summary: Higgsfield creates AI video and image tools for creators, brands, agencies and studios. It raised a $400 million Series B at a $5.4 billion valuation in August 2026.
overview: Higgsfield is a generative-media platform with tools for creating AI images and video. It sells into creative and marketing workflows, while competing in a compute-intensive and fast-moving category.

facts.label: Latest financing
facts.note: Reported Series B valuation; Higgsfield said the financing quadrupled its valuation in eight months.

bull_case: Strong creator and enterprise adoption could make Higgsfield a major production layer for marketing and media workflows.
bear_case: Video generation has heavy compute needs and intense competition; the $5.4B valuation assumes impressive revenue and adoption can persist.
directory_notes: Public financing and operating data remain limited.

intelligence.description: Generative-media suite for image, video, editing and creative production workflows.
company: Higgsfield provides AI tools for video and image creation, including products aimed at filmmakers and marketing teams. Its core market is professional creative production rather than a purely consumer novelty app.

The company announced a $400 million Series B at a $5.4 billion valuation in August 2026, led by DST Global. It said it had reached $700 million of annualized revenue, 30 million users and 390 Fortune 500 customers; those operating figures are company-reported.
Sacra reported that Higgsfield reached $1 billion in annualized revenue in September 2026.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Higgsfield is a high-valuation test of whether generative video becomes an enduring enterprise production tool. Compute economics and retention will determine whether its rapid growth is durable.

changed.text: Higgsfield is founded in San Francisco to build AI tools for video and image creation.
A Series A establishes a reported $1.3B valuation.
A $400M Series B raises the reported valuation to $5.4B.

takeaways: Higgsfield sells a broader creative suite, spanning image, video, editing, effects and API access.
The $400M Series B and $5.4B valuation are reported by TechCrunch, while the company's operating figures are company-reported.
The underwriting question is whether creative teams retain the product as models and distribution channels evolve.

sources.label: Reuters: Higgsfield Series A at $1.3B valuation
